purpose: Resolve one registered Purpose Workspace context into an evidence-bounded no-effect coordination plan while preserving role, authority, observation, review, authorization and external-effect boundaries.
applicabilityRules: requested task belongs to the selected domain
sourceResolutionRules: resolve the canonical Purpose Workspace registry and selected domain pack
resolve the task process pattern and completion contract
preserve source/currentness distinctions and held external effects
preconditions: requested semantic depth is DO, UNDERSTAND or STEWARD
effectOwnerRule: This process forms a declarative coordination projection only; any external effect remains separately owned and separately authorized.
returnRouteRule: return the bounded Purpose Workspace projection and unresolved blockers to the caller
closureRule: close only when the requested projection is formed or an explicit blocker is returned
recoveryRule: discard derived projection and rebuild from current source-managed Purpose Workspace records
